glance.headline: AWS will be a $1T business
glance.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and reach $1 trillion in revenue. To do that, it must continue its capex spending spree, its CEO Jassy said Thursday.
glance.why: Amazon is spending heavily to become the king of AI cloud computing and reach $1 trillion in revenue.

explain.kid: Amazon wants to make a trillion dollars in revenue. To do that, it has to spend lots of money on AI cloud computing.
explain.pm: Amazon aims to reach $1 trillion in revenue and lead AI cloud computing by continuing its capex spending spree.
explain.engineer: Amazon must continue its capex spending spree to dominate AI cloud computing and become a $1 trillion revenue business.

glance.headline: DOJ cracks down on AI “ghost student” fraud
glance.summary: DOJ says thousands of “ghost students” use AI to steal millions in student loans. Applying for FAFSA may get messy as the DOJ crackdown ramps up.
Thrive Holdings is buying ADT to integrate AI into home security systems.
Google Gemini now allows users to generate and edit various file types directly in chats.

big_pour.headline: Thrive Holdings acquires ADT for AI security
big_pour.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is purchasing ADT in a deal worth 15.3 billion dollars. The company plans to bring AI technology into the home security business.

office_blend.headline: Worldwide Express automates freight billing
office_blend.summary: Worldwide Express used Amazon Bedrock to build a multi-agent system for freight billing. The company cut active exceptions by 75% and improved cash flow by 10 million dollars.

office_blend.headline: MoEngage turns APIs into agent tools
office_blend.summary: MoEngage converted 400 private APIs into secure agent tools using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. This approach avoids public endpoints and reduces technical complexity.

still_roasting.summary: DeepMind is preparing to release Genie 4, a world model that features more realistic physics and human movement.

quick_sips.summary: Fujifilm is increasing magnetic tape production fivefold to meet rising demand for offline AI data archiving.
Meta launched Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that creates a virtual closet from Instagram photos.
Granola added a dictation feature to its meeting notetaker to compete with other voice AI apps.

stories.label: New orchestration system
stories.headline: GitHub debuts Copilot Fusion for coding
stories.summary: GitHub released Copilot Fusion, a system that manages model selection and orchestration for coding tasks to reduce API costs.

stories.label: Agentic workflows
stories.headline: Replit CEO eyes new organizational structures
stories.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad suggests that AI agents performing routine execution could eventually make traditional organizational charts obsolete.

concept.explanation: Orchestration refers to a system that handles model selection and task management. In the case of GitHub Copilot Fusion, it automates the process of choosing the right model for specific coding tasks.

long_read.headline: AI is overwhelming and I’m doing it wrong
long_read.summary: This newsletter reflects on the feeling of being overwhelmed by the rapid pace of AI development and questions the current approach to keeping up.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.
